name: Ye Ran High School
desc: Where the Noblesse enrolls as a new transfer student.
events: You help a classmate and receive a reward from the grateful student council.
You find a forgotten bag in the hallway with a few coins inside.
A quiet afternoon on the rooftop leaves you refreshed and a little richer.
setbacks: You get scolded by a teacher and pay for a broken window.

name: Noble Mansion
desc: A quiet estate hiding centuries of noble history.
events: You discover a sealed cabinet in the cellar and pry it open.
The mansion's guardian rewards you for your discipline.
A dusty ledger leads you to forgotten savings.
setbacks: A hidden trap drains some of your coins.

name: Union Outpost
desc: A hostile Union base full of equipment and danger.
events: You sneak past guards and loot a supply crate.
You hack a terminal and extract valuable data.
A fleeing agent drops a cash case.
setbacks: An alarm trips and you pay a bribe to escape.

name: Neighborhood Cafe
desc: A calm cafe with regulars who know more than they say.
events: The owner gifts you a free meal and a tip jar.
A regular shares a rumor worth a few coins.
You win a small bet in a card game.
setbacks: The bill is steeper than expected.

name: Ramen Shop
desc: The Noblesse's favorite place on earth.
events: The chef is impressed by your appetite and gives you a bonus.
You finish a giant bowl and win the shop challenge.
A stranger pays your tab and slips you a tip.
setbacks: You order too much and the bill hurts.

name: Quiet Apartment
desc: A modest home base with surprising hidden storage.
events: You find a stash behind the loose floorboard.
A neighbor repays an old favor.
Cleaning the closet reveals forgotten valuables.

name: Wolf Den
desc: Dangerous grounds crawling with wolf-line hunters.
events: You fend off a pack and claim their hoard.
A wounded hunter trades supplies for protection.
You track a trail to a hidden cache.
setbacks: A pack ambush forces you to abandon some gold.

name: Ancient Ruins
desc: Ruins older than any living Noble.
events: You decipher an old mural that reveals a treasure room.
A collapsing corridor exposes a gleaming relic.
You solve a stone puzzle and open a vault.
setbacks: A cave-in costs you part of your haul.

name: Darkwood Forest
desc: A dense forest where beasts and hunters roam.
events: You hunt down a beast and sell its pelt.
You find rare herbs growing near a stream.
A lost traveler rewards you for guiding them out.
setbacks: You get lost and waste supplies.

name: Neon City Streets
desc: A sprawling city full of rumors and opportunity.
events: You break up a street fight and the shop owner rewards you.
A pickpocket drops his loot while fleeing.
A night market sale nets you a profit.

name: Forgotten Laboratory
desc: An abandoned lab with unstable experiments.
events: You salvage prototype components from a broken pod.
A surviving terminal unlocks a research stockpile.
You neutralize a rogue subject and claim its core.
setbacks: A containment breach damages your gear.
